about: The narrator's lines for the second cut (07-revision-v2.md). Locked by the lead on 2026-11-10. One file per line; place by frame. Act 1 lines carry the quiet tag; Act 2 lines are untagged. Never stitch across the act boundary.

lines.text: A ghost story... about a keypad that learned to talk.
lines.note: Opens the film over the static. The pause at the ellipsis may be used to split the line.

lines.text: Nine keys. One press per letter.
lines.note: Over the keys pressing themselves.

lines.text: And the phone worked out the word.
lines.note: Hello is on the screen.

lines.text: Then glass replaced the keys... and the keypad went quiet.
lines.note: The dark drawer. May be split at the pause.

lines.text: But old is not the same as bad.
lines.note: Black, the pale dot; the line appears in pixel type.

lines.text: It still has something to say.
lines.note: The dot warms to ember. Must end by 27.0 s.

lines.text: This is Ninth Life. The old phone keypad, back as a way to talk.
lines.note: After the drop, over the title.

lines.text: Some people type to talk, for an afternoon, or for good.
lines.note: The problem starts: the other person's bubble.

lines.text: But small keys are hard to hit.
lines.note: A fingertip ring misses a small key.

lines.text: With one switch, every letter is a wait.
lines.note: The scan highlight crawls letter by letter.

lines.text: The conversation moves on.
lines.note: Their next bubbles arrive.

lines.text: And a language model can put words in your mouth.
lines.note: A grey suggestion offers words nobody typed.

lines.text: So, nine big keys. One press per letter.
lines.note: Right after the fold lands.

lines.text: It finds the sentence. You press Speak.
lines.note: Before the app says I need water.

lines.text: A language model can help sort the guesses, if you turn it on.
lines.note: The opt-in model card offers wafer.

lines.text: But every word must match your keys.
lines.note: The digits are compared.

lines.text: So it can never put words in your mouth.
lines.note: Wafer is dropped; water keeps its check.

lines.text: No signal? It still works. We call it ghost mode.
lines.note: The phone offline.

lines.text: Use touch, a keyboard, or one switch.
lines.note: Three ways in.

lines.text: Same keys. A ninth life.
lines.note: Then and now.

lines.text: Ninth Life. Free, in your browser.
lines.note: End card.

app_voice_new.note: The app's last line (Angela, the same model and settings as the three existing app lines). Replaces 'It is good to be back.' in the film.
